title: Evidence review view
description: review/review.json in an evidence/v1 export: a view derived from records.ndjson that lists the plan gate decisions and the records made by reviewer agents. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the view equals what DeriveViews produces from the records (entries in chain order; each entry's sequence, ev_id and record_hash name a real record); the file exists only when there is at least one decision or reviewer record; at most 1 MiB.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

decisions.description: The PlanGateDecided.v1 records; absent when there are none.

reviewer_records.description: The records whose actor_kind is reviewer-agent; absent when there are none.

action.description: A capability name port.verb or a versioned lifecycle event name such as PlanGateDecided.v1.

actor.description: The actor principal name; printable ASCII, at most 256 bytes.
